title: Flight Assist Configuration
description:
AGENTS: before modifying this schema, read AGENTS.md at the repository root.

Inertial damping settings for accessibility. See ADR-0010, ADR-0012, ADR-0013.

enabled_by_default.description: Whether flight assist is enabled on startup. When true, inertial damping is active from the first frame of gameplay.

damping_coefficient.description: Velocity damping strength when flight assist is active (0-1). 0 = no damping, 1 = full stop (velocity zeroed in one tick).
